procedure: Run board-detection tooling against the attached ESP32-S3 device.
Record the detected serial port, chip family, USB transport, and hardware serial.
expected_result: The attached ESP32-S3 is visible over native USB/JTAG serial for later firmware smoke tests.
observed_result: The board was detected on /dev/cu.usbmodem101 as ESP32-S3 native USB/JTAG serial with serial EC:DA:3B:95:32:98.
limitations: This report records detection only; it is not a flash, display, GPIO, camera, or signing smoke test.
